description: List the open tickets and return an object that maps each assignee to the ids of their open tickets whose `severity` is `high` or `critical`, with each list of ids sorted alphabetically. Leave out an assignee who has no such ticket.

types.Ticket: Record {id: String, assignee: String, severity: String}

capabilities.description: Lists the tickets with the given status: open or closed. Severity is low, medium, high, or critical.
